hypothesis: Learning U1, which decodes e2 for the W1 update, retains useful post-change adaptation while fixed U0, B and V limit old-fact loss versus frozen feedback.
primary_metric: Per-seed equal mean of novel CE at steps544..768 every32 and drift CE at1056..1280 every32 (16 checkpoints); arithmetic mean of three paired relative CE reductions.
minimum_useful_effect: Mean relative CE reduction>=5%; every seed>=0%.
success_rule: All finite/fidelity/data/replay/preservation gates; mean paired U1-only versus frozen CE reduction >=5% and no negative seed; U1-only old-window and final-old accuracy at most2pp worse than frozen in every seed. Secondary readout arms cannot replace the primary.
futility_rule: No tuning or added seeds. Stop on fidelity, preservation, pilot numerical failure or exhausted budget; preserve all failed arms. Main arm failure invalidates the primary gate. Retention or effect failure means no promotion.

design.mechanism_equations: RULE_MAPPING.md. W update unchanged. Active U_next=cap(U-0.05*g_U), no online feedback decay. B1/B2/V1/V2 always fixed; inactive U fixed. U0 decodes e1 for W0, U1 decodes e2 for W1. Common warmup retains original full feedback learning+decay.

arms.backprop_fifo: Exact BP forward update; all feedback unused/fixed.
arms.frozen_fifo: Local forward update; all feedback fixed at common warmup.
arms.u0_only_fifo: Local forward update; U0 learns at original rate; B/V/U1 fixed; no feedback decay.
arms.u1_only_fifo: Local forward update; U1 learns at original rate; B/V/U0 fixed; no feedback decay. W0 still learns using fixed U0.
arms.both_u_fifo: Local forward update; U0/U1 learn; B/V fixed; no feedback decay. W/U/B equivalent to preserved V/U-only under fixed B, verified before pilot.

design.control_rationale: 2x2 U0 learning on/off x U1 learning on/off after identical warmup, plus exact BP. Same FIFO512/16, current16, W optimizer, data/query/replay, model/exposure and one configuration. Sole primary U1-only versus frozen tests adaptation with retention. U0-only and both-U are explanatory controls. W0 continues learning in every local arm; this is not a fixed-feature model. With B fixed, V affects only disabled B drives; both-U and V/U-only share W/U/B dynamics but differ in V.

Inherited family/component/cap checks retain their fixed seeds, including original failed-cap regression15817. No seed search/exclusion/selection.
